title: Indore Gets India’s First Virtual Zoo
summary: Indore in Madhya Pradesh has India’s first virtual zoo at the Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya, also known as the Indore Zoological Museum. The facility covers 8,000 square feet and was developed under a Public-Private Partnership model at a...

blocks.content: Indore in Madhya Pradesh has India’s first virtual zoo at the Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya, also known as the Indore Zoological Museum. The facility covers 8,000 square feet and was developed under a Public-Private Partnership model at an estimated cost of ₹4.5 crore.

items: Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya is the zoological museum in Indore where the virtual zoo has been set up.
Public-Private Partnership, or PPP, is a model in which a government body and a private entity share project responsibilities.
